about: M0 test set. Read each 'text' aloud naturally, the way you would say it to a friend or an AI agent (don't read it word by word). 'english' lists words that must come out in English spelling. Audio files go to spec/fixtures/audio/<id>.wav (not committed). Silence items (text empty) check that an engine writes nothing when nobody speaks.
